elyza.surrogate.gp.gp module#

Vanilla Gaussian Process regression.

Defines GaussianProcess, a Surrogate that combines a pluggable BaseKernel and BaseMean, fits hyperparameters via a pluggable Optimizer on the negative log-marginal-likelihood, and supports rank-1 (block Cholesky) updates for online data ingestion.

fit(X: ndarray | Array, Y: ndarray | Array)[source]#

Fit kernel/mean/noise hyperparameters to training data.

On the first call, this also fits the input standard-scaler, data-driven-initializes the hyperparameters (see _smart_init()), and (optionally) calibrates the noise variance for numerical conditioning.

Parameters:

  • X – Training inputs, shape (n_samples, input_dim).

  • Y – Training outputs, shape (n_samples, output_dim).

Raises:

AssertionError – If set_optimizer() has not been called yet.

predict(X, full_cov=False) → tuple[Array][source]#

Compute the posterior mean and covariance at new points.

Parameters:

  • X – Query inputs, shape (n_samples, input_dim).

  • full_cov – If True, return the full posterior covariance matrix; otherwise return only the marginal variances.

Returns:

(mu, cov) where mu has shape (n_samples,) and cov is either the full covariance matrix, shape (n_samples, n_samples), or the marginal variances, shape (n_samples,).

Return type:

tuple[jax.Array]

sample(key, X, n_samples: int = 1) → Array[source]#

Draw samples from the GP posterior at X.

Uses the reparameterization trick, treating each point independently (using only the marginal variances from predict(X, full_cov=False) rather than the full posterior covariance) so this stays cheap for large X: z ~ N(0, I), sample = mu + sqrt(var) * z. Keeping mu/var in the computation graph (rather than e.g. jax.random.multivariate_normal) makes the samples differentiable w.r.t. the posterior mean and variance.

Parameters:

  • key – A JAX PRNG key.

  • X – Query inputs, shape (n_samples, input_dim).

  • n_samples – Number of independent samples to draw per point.

Returns:

Samples, shape (n_samples_X, n_samples).

Return type:

jax.Array

set_optimizer(optimizer: BatchGradientOptimizer, optimizer_opts: OptimizerOptions)[source]#

Assign the optimizer (and its options) used by fit().

Parameters:

  • optimizer_opts – An OptimizerOptions instance configuring that optimizer.

update(X: ndarray | Array, Y: ndarray | Array) → None[source]#

Incorporate new observations via a rank-m block Cholesky update.

Extends the cached Cholesky factor self._L in place using the Schur complement of the new block, avoiding a full O(n^3) Cholesky recomputation over all training data.

Parameters:

  • X – New inputs, shape (m, input_dim).

  • Y – New outputs, shape (m, output_dim).

Raises:

RuntimeError – If fit() has not been called at least once.
